description.text:
Battle Party: Dream Together (对战派对 共梦) is a box of ready-made decks for a battle party of up to eight players. It came in two parts. Part one (上) came out on 28 February 2025 with nine decks, eight of them in each box; part two (下) followed on 18 April 2025 with 14 decks, the nine of part one among them, again eight to a box. Each box held eight 60-card decks with a card explaining how each plays, eight sheets of paper damage counters, four coins, a one-card King's Reward Pack (王者奖赏包) for the winner and 20 Collect 151 event packs to hand out by result. With luck the eight decks included the Mewtwo VSTAR deck, or its holo version, the same cards in holo.

The decks draw on cards from the Sword & Shield and Scarlet & Violet series. Part one has Venusaur ex, Charizard ex and Blastoise ex decks, a Single Strike Tyranitar V deck, an Electrode deck built on Pokémon Tools, Regigigas with the other Regis, a Rapid Strike Sylveon VMAX deck and the Mewtwo VSTAR deck; part two added others such as Machamp VMAX with Lucario, Delphox with Serena, Arbok ex, Fusion Strike and Raichu V. At first the boxes could be played only at Battle Party: Dream Together events in shops, from 28 February to 8 April 2025 for part one and from 18 April to 25 May for part two. From 19 December 2025 single decks were sold in Battle Party: Dream Together Deck boxes, one of 15 at random, the holo Mewtwo VSTAR deck among them. Its cards are numbered out of 177; a second Professor's Research is numbered 178.
